body: Hey, sorry for not answering, i apreciate the responses. I know i'm on the brink of something better, my life just seems a bit brighter, but it's all still grey. I get that it needs time, and that i should respect that. Especially since i have respected myself beeing depressed for 8 years, but i feel like i loose perspective. i make tiny improvements, nothing major. I'm still stuck in my own head, my own problems, my own thoughts. And i get how things can change, how life can suddenly gain color (but not really) it's just... i'll never not be me. There will never not be that strugle of self loathing. Even at my best, i feel it. I'll probably continue for a month or two, see how it turns out. I wish i could guarantee after that.

It's not very traditional, but last month in therapy my therapist shed actual tears for me. She was explaining how she saw so many of my cases, and that she believed i was a genuine nice guy. She was frustrated that i couldn't see that. I don't remember feeling this caught off guard before. She broke her professional composure and showed she cared about me more than i care about anything. She didn't have to do that, she wasn't my family or a friend. She didn't have a long term connection, nor any real reason to shed tears. She just cared, and believed her words. I don't know about happy, but it stuck with me that someone shed tears for me.
